title: White Crochet doilies
text: White Crochet doilies. These are exactly what I needed.  Various sizes.  Soft white.  Feels like cotton or cotton blend.  Washed and dried nicely.  The various sizes means I always have one that will work.  Are they as fine as grandma made?  No.  They are not heirlooms.  But someone actually made them.  I like them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
